summary.text: Future Sight takes place on Dominaria, where temporal rifts let Phyrexian horrors cross into the present, and Freyalise gives her spark and her life to close one of them.

Karn enters the Tolaria rift and returns to the moment before Barrin's spell, sealing the rift before it opens at the cost of being lost himself, so Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for him just as Leshrac returns.
The Great Mending then closes planar portals and heals Dominaria's fractures, and planeswalkers lose their immortality.
